parts.rootsDesc: Roots hold the plant in soil and drink up water and minerals.
parts.stemDesc: The strong stem carries water and nutrients up to leaves.
parts.leafDesc: Leaves catch sunlight and make yummy food for the plant.
parts.flowerDesc: Flowers make seeds and attract bees and butterflies.
parts.fruitDesc: Fruit protects seeds and is tasty to eat.
parts.seedDesc: Each seed can grow into a whole new plant!

needs.sunDesc: Gives warm energy to make food
needs.waterDesc: Keeps the plant fresh and strong

body.eyesFact: Your eyes blink about 15 times every minute to stay clean!
body.earsFact: Your ears also help you balance when you run and jump!
body.noseFact: Your nose can remember thousands of different smells!
body.mouthFact: Your tongue has taste buds for sweet, salty, and sour flavors!
body.heartFact: Your heart beats about 100 times a minute to pump fresh blood!
body.lungsFact: Lungs take in oxygen from air every time you breathe in!
body.bonesFact: Bones protect your brain, heart, and help you stand tall!
body.handsFact: Your fingertips have unique patterns called fingerprints!

cow.name: Cow
cow.fact: Cows give us nutritious milk and love grazing in open fields.

sheep.name: Sheep
sheep.fact: Sheep have warm wool that helps make cozy winter sweaters.

horse.name: Horse
horse.fact: Horses can sleep both lying down and standing up!

lion.name: Lion
lion.fact: The lion is known as the King of the Jungle!

elephant.name: Elephant
elephant.fact: Elephants are the largest land animals and use trunks like a hand.

monkey.name: Monkey
monkey.fact: Monkeys use their strong tails to swing between tree branches.

dolphin.name: Dolphin
dolphin.fact: Dolphins are super friendly and jump high out of the waves.

clownfish.name: Clownfish
clownfish.fact: Bright orange clownfish live safely inside sea anemones.

octopus.name: Octopus
octopus.fact: An octopus has 8 flexible arms and 3 hearts!

parrot.name: Parrot
parrot.fact: Parrots are colorful birds that can learn to repeat words!

penguin.name: Penguin
penguin.fact: Penguins cannot fly in the air, but are great swimmers in water!

owl.name: Owl
owl.fact: Owls can see clearly in the dark night and turn their heads all around.

butterfly.name: Butterfly
butterfly.fact: A caterpillar transforms into a beautiful winged butterfly!

bee.name: Honeybee
bee.fact: Bees help flowers grow and make delicious sweet honey.

ladybug.name: Ladybug
ladybug.fact: Ladybugs have bright red coats with black polka dots.

space.dayTime: Daytime: The Sun gives us light & warmth!
space.nightTime: Nighttime: Earth turns away from the Sun!

sun.name: The Sun
sun.fact: The Sun is a huge glowing ball of fire that gives Earth light and life.

moon.name: The Moon
moon.fact: The Moon orbits Earth and shines bright by reflecting sunlight.

earth.name: Planet Earth
earth.fact: Earth is our blue planet with oceans, trees, animals, and people!

mercury.name: Mercury
mercury.fact: Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun and is super speedy.

mars.name: Mars
mars.fact: Mars has red rusty dust and huge mountains and canyons.

jupiter.name: Jupiter
jupiter.fact: Jupiter is a giant gas planet with a famous giant red storm spot.

saturn.name: Saturn
saturn.fact: Saturn is famous for its gorgeous rings made of ice and rock chunks.

stars.name: Distant Stars
stars.fact: Stars twinkle in the night sky and form fun shapes called constellations.

water.statesSubtitle: Water can freeze into ice or boil into steam!

water.liquidDesc: Water you drink and bathe with flows freely as a liquid.
water.gasDesc: When water gets very hot, it evaporates into invisible warm vapor.
water.evapDesc: Sun warms the lakes and oceans, lifting water vapor up into the sky.
water.condDesc: Water vapor cools down and gathers into fluffy white clouds.
water.precipDesc: When clouds get heavy, water drops fall as gentle rain or snow.
water.collectDesc: Rainwater flows into rivers and returns to oceans to start again!

earth.title: Our Wonderful Earth
earth.oceansDesc: 70% of Earth is covered with salty blue water full of sea life.
earth.landDesc: Sturdy green land where trees, animals, and cities thrive.
earth.forestsDesc: Forests are Earth's green lungs providing clean oxygen.
earth.careDesc: Planting trees, saving water, and keeping our planet clean!

float.leafExp: Leaves are light and flat, so they float gently on top!
float.rockExp: Rocks are heavy and dense, so they sink straight to the bottom!
float.boatExp: Boats have hollow shape that traps air, helping them float!
float.coinExp: Heavy metals are dense and sink in water.
float.appleExp: Apples have 25% air inside, which lets them bob on water!
float.keyExp: Solid metal keys sink down to the tank floor.

quiz.q1: What does a plant need to grow strong and healthy?
quiz.q1.exp: Plants need sunlight, water, soil, and air to grow!
quiz.q2: Which part of our body do we use to see colors and books?
quiz.q2.exp: Our eyes give us the sense of sight!
quiz.q3: What gives planet Earth warmth and daylight?
quiz.q3.exp: The Sun is our closest star and lights up our daytime!
quiz.q4: Which of these animals loves swimming in the ocean?
quiz.q4.exp: Dolphins are playful sea mammals that swim in ocean waters!
quiz.q5: What should you take when it is rainy outside?
quiz.q5.exp: An umbrella protects you from raindrops!
quiz.q6: Which object will float on top of water?
quiz.q6.exp: Leaves are light and float on water!
quiz.q7: Which organ inside your chest pumps blood?
quiz.q7.exp: Your heart beats constantly to pump blood throughout your body!
quiz.q8: What color do you get when you mix Red and Blue?
quiz.q9: What part of a plant grows underground and drinks water?
quiz.q9.exp: Roots anchor the plant firmly in the soil and absorb water & minerals!
quiz.q10: Which body organ helps you think, learn, and remember?
quiz.q10.exp: The brain is your body's super smart control center!
quiz.q11: Which planet is our home in the Solar System?
quiz.q11.exp: Earth is our beautiful blue planet filled with plants, animals, and water!
quiz.q12: Which animal has colorful feathers and can fly?
quiz.q12.exp: Birds like parrots have wings and feathers to soar in the sky!
quiz.q13: What happens to water when it gets very cold and freezes?
quiz.q13.exp: Water freezes into solid cold ice cubes when temperatures drop!
quiz.q14: How many beautiful colors are in a rainbow?
quiz.q14.exp: A rainbow has 7 colors: Violet, Indigo, Blue, Green, Yellow, Orange & Red!
quiz.q15: Which of these gentle animals gives us fresh milk and eats grass?
quiz.q15.exp: Cows are herbivores that eat grass and provide healthy milk!
quiz.q16: Which organ in your chest fills with air every time you breathe in?
quiz.q16.exp: Our lungs take in fresh oxygen from the air around us!
quiz.q17: What color do you get when you mix Yellow and Blue?
quiz.q18: What is a young baby plant called after it sprouts from a seed?
quiz.q18.exp: A tiny seed sprouts into a baby seedling and grows towards the sunlight!
quiz.q19: Which tool attracts metal paperclips and iron pins?
quiz.q19.exp: Magnets have magnetic power to attract iron and steel objects!
quiz.q20: Which celestial body shines at night and changes its shape each month?
quiz.q20.exp: The Moon orbits Earth and shows different phases from crescent to full moon!

clock.title: Learn the Clock
clock.desc: Hour hand, minute hand & telling time

clock.introHandsDesc: The short blue hand tells the hour. The long red hand tells the minutes!
clock.oclock3Desc: When the long red hand points at 12, it is o'clock! Short hand points at 3, so it is 3:00!
clock.halfPast3Desc: When the red hand points down at 6, half an hour (30 minutes) has passed!
clock.oclock4Desc: Now the short blue hand is on 4 and the red hand is on 12. It's 4:00!
clock.halfPast5Desc: Short hand is between 5 and 6, and long hand points at 6. That is 5:30!
clock.dragHint: Touch or drag hands around the clock face!

challenge.set300Exp: The short hand points at 3 and the long hand points at 12.
challenge.set330: Set the clock hands to 3:30 (Half Past 3)!
challenge.set330Exp: Short hand is near 3 and long hand is pointing straight down at 6.
challenge.set400Exp: Short hand points at 4 and long hand at 12.
challenge.set530: Set the clock hands to 5:30 (Half Past 5)!
challenge.set530Exp: Short hand is between 5 and 6, and long hand points at 6.
challenge.set700Exp: Short hand points at 7 and long hand points at 12.
challenge.set930Exp: Short hand is between 9 and 10, long hand at 6.

afternoon.name: Afternoon

evening.name: Evening

night.name: Night
night.desc: The moon and stars appear. Time to rest and have sweet dreams!

months.marHighlight: Spring flowers bloom and pleasant sunshine.
months.julHighlight: Puddles, paper boats and cloudy skies.
months.novHighlight: Cool winter breeze and Children's Day.
months.decHighlight: Christmas carols, holidays and year-end joy!

summer.name: Summer
summer.weather: Hot and sunny days with bright blue skies.
summer.clothes: Light cotton t-shirts, shorts, hats and sunglasses.
summer.activities: Swimming, eating ice cream and drinking coconut water!
summer.funFact: Summer days have the longest daylight hours in the year!

rainy.name: Rainy / Monsoon
rainy.weather: Dark clouds, heavy showers, thunder and rainbows.
rainy.clothes: Raincoats, gumboots and holding colorful umbrellas.
rainy.activities: Floating paper boats, splashing in puddles and watching peacocks.
rainy.funFact: Rainwater fills rivers and helps farmers grow delicious crops!

autumn.name: Autumn
autumn.weather: Cool, pleasant breeze and golden sunshine.
autumn.clothes: Light jackets, full sleeves and cozy vests.
autumn.activities: Collecting colorful fallen leaves and outdoor cycling.
autumn.funFact: Tree leaves turn yellow, orange, and red before falling gently!

winter.name: Winter
winter.weather: Cold, chilly winds, morning fog and snowflakes in the mountains.
winter.clothes: Warm woolen sweaters, mufflers, gloves and beanies.
winter.activities: Drinking hot cocoa, building snowmen and enjoying campfires.
winter.funFact: Some animals hibernate and sleep throughout the cold winter!

quiz.qClock300: What time does this clock show?
quiz.expClock300: Short hand is at 3 and long hand is at 12, so it is 3:00!
quiz.qDayAfterTue: What day comes right after Tuesday?
quiz.qClock530: What time does this clock show?
quiz.expClock530: Long hand points at 6 (30 mins) and short hand is between 5 and 6: 5:30!
quiz.qYesterdayMon: If Today is Monday, what was Yesterday?
quiz.expYesterdayMon: Sunday is the day before Monday!
quiz.qTomorrowFri: If Today is Friday, what day is Tomorrow?
quiz.qFirstMonth: Which month is the first month of the year?
quiz.expFirstMonth: January is the 1st month of every year!
quiz.qSeasonUmbrella: In which season do we use umbrellas and raincoats?
quiz.expSeasonUmbrella: We use umbrellas in the Rainy (Monsoon) season!
quiz.qDayPartsBreakfast: In which part of the day do we eat breakfast?
quiz.expDayPartsBreakfast: We eat breakfast in the morning after waking up!
quiz.qClock400: What time does this clock show?
quiz.expClock400: Short hand is at 4 and long hand at 12, which is 4:00!
quiz.qCalendarDaysWeek: How many days are there in one week?
quiz.expCalendarDaysWeek: There are 7 days in a week: Monday to Sunday!
quiz.qMonthsInYear: How many months are there in one year?
quiz.expMonthsInYear: There are 12 months in one full year!
